verdict.rationale: Shopify's own developer docs describe POS UI extensions as an official way to build custom functionality into the POS app. Developers scaffold projects with Shopify CLI, use target APIs (cart updates, discounts, toasts), call runtime APIs such as shopify.storage and shopify.action.presentModal(), use cross-platform web components, and query the GraphQL Admin API directly. missing for 10: explicit naming of installable SDK packages and supported languages or versions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the developer experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: With Shopify POS UI extensions, you can add custom functionality directly into Shopify's point-of-sale interface.
Use Shopify CLI to scaffold your extension with the essential configuration and files.
Target APIs read data and perform operations in Shopify POS like updating cart details, applying discounts, or showing a toast.
shopify.storage persists data between sessions, shopify.toast displays feedback messages, and shopify.action.presentModal() launches full-screen workflows.
Use web components to build interfaces that automatically adapt across iOS and Android devices running Shopify POS.
